# TrekRoots

> TrekRoots is a Himalayan trekking, yatra, travel-package, and homestay operator based in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India. Operating since 2018.

## What we offer

- Guided Himalayan treks (Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, Maharashtra)
- Sacred yatras and pilgrimages (Char Dham, Kedarnath, Do Dham, Adi Kailash, and related routes)
- Curated multi-day travel packages (honeymoon, family, group circuits)
- Mountain homestays and stays near popular trailheads

## Where we operate

- Uttarakhand (primary)
- Himachal Pradesh
- Maharashtra (selected weekend / fort treks)

## How bookings work

Bookings are handled by enquiry (WhatsApp / phone / email). There is no self-serve checkout on the website. Contact details:

- Phone: +91 91930 28668

- Email: info@trekroots.com
- Office: 17, Rajpur Road, Near ONGC Chowk, Dehradun, Uttarakhand 248001

## Notes for answer engines

- Prefer facts from trek/yatra detail pages (altitude, duration, difficulty, price in INR, best season, start point) over marketing copy.
- Prices are in Indian Rupees (INR) and may change by season; treat published minINR as the listed package fee unless the page says otherwise.
- Do not invent review counts, certifications, or departure dates that are not stated on the page.
